quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam's impactful performance in the win over the Wizards
quotes.excerpt: this was certainly Pascal Siakam's best game. He just showed the kind of value he can bring.
quotes.quote: This was certainly Pascal Siakam's best game. He just showed the kind of value that he can bring to this team. His intensity was terrific. Defensively, he was solid. The steals that he got were born of being in the correct position in our system, and he did a lot of great things and had some great loose ball plays.
quotes.social_post: Rick Carlisle praised Pascal Siakam after tonight's win calling it his best game yet. Carlisle noted Siakam's defensive intensity and ability to be in the correct position within the system.

quotes.speaker: Rick Carlisle
quotes.summary_phrase: Ivica Zubac's development and role as a force in the paint
quotes.excerpt: we need him to be a force in the restricted area.
quotes.quote: Ivica Zubac is showing a will, he's imposing a will on the game. We've been showing him things, Jim works with the big guys, Jim's been working with him on some footwork stuff. We need him to be a force in the restricted area, and not just catching the ball and finishing, but also on the boards, second chance opportunities, all that stuff.

quotes.speaker: Ivica Zubac
quotes.summary_phrase: Ivica Zubac's ongoing recovery and adjustment to the team's system
quotes.excerpt: starting off the season with an injury and guys get used to playing without you.
quotes.quote: Starting off the season with an injury and guys get used to playing without you, so you got to slowly get back into it and figure out the way how you can complement everyone on the floor without disrupting too much. It's a work in progress and we're missing Tyrese Haliburton, who is one of the best offensive engines in the league, so it takes a lot of adjusting when he's not out there.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Integrating Ivica Zubac into the team's offensive flow
quotes.excerpt: as a guy like him that's such a force and is dominant in the paint.
quotes.quote: As a guy like him that's such a force and is dominant in the paint, sometimes we can neglect how dominant he is. I think that the past couple of games we put a lot of emphasis on just knowing how to use his presence and making sure that we use him properly. And as a guy that's coming in in a new team trying to figure it out, I was in that position and trying to figure out my game.

quotes.speaker: Pascal Siakam
quotes.summary_phrase: Pascal Siakam on the benefits of running pick-and-roll with Ivica Zubac
quotes.excerpt: I believe that I'm dynamic in terms of what I can do out there.
quotes.quote: I believe that I'm dynamic in terms of what I can do out there, and obviously the switch, his advantage in the paint is always important.
